card.name: Modifier words in fixed label sentences
card.fires_on: The adjective right before a noun in set label sentences, mainly "recurrent" in "risk of recurrent CV thrombotic events" (NSAID MI warning). Also "ongoing antibiotic" in the C. difficile warning.

modes.label: recurrent before CV events
modes.description: The word "recurrent" after "risk of" in the NSAID warning about recent MI.
modes.example: outweigh the risk of<< recurrent>> CV thrombotic events. If nap

modes.label: antibiotic in CDAD warning
modes.description: The word "antibiotic" after "ongoing" when C. difficile diarrhea is suspected.
modes.example: If CDAD is suspected or confirmed, ongoing<< antibiotic>> use not directed against C. difficile may

modes.label: therapeutic before agents
modes.description: The word "therapeutic" after "several" in the NSAID note on CV effects of other drugs.
modes.example: may blunt the CV effects of several<< therapeutic>> agents used to treat these medical conditions (
